title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Census - Permit
description: The license/authorization of a commercial space, terrace or economic activity (edintcom:Permit). NOTE: unrelated to, and a distinct concept from, edint-censo-vehiculos's own 'Permit' entity (vehicle circulation/parking permits) -- same entity type NAME, entirely different meaning; a genuine type collision, not resolved here. See standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Permit'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the permit in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'LIC-CAF-0001'.

fileCode.description: Property. The administrative file/case code of the permit, e.g. '2021/EXP/45872' (edintcom:fileCode).

issuedTo.description: Relationship. The CommercialEntity this permit is issued to (edintcom:issuedTo).

appliedTo.description: Relationship. The CommercialSpace or Terrace this permit applies to (edintcom:appliedTo).

hasCommercialPermitType.description: Property. The type of commercial permit, from the CommercialPermitType controlled vocabulary (edintcom:hasCommercialPermitType), e.g. APAL (opening/activity license).

hasCommercialPermitStatus.description: Property. The permit's current status, from the CommercialPermitStatus controlled vocabulary (edintcom:hasCommercialPermitStatus).

hasCNAECode.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of Spain's official CNAE-2025 economic activity classification (edintcom:hasCNAECode).

hasIAECode.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of Spain's official IAE tax classification (edintcom:hasIAECode).

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date the permit becomes effective (schema:startDate).

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date the permit expires, if applicable (schema:endDate).
